assessment_scope.source_boundary: TRPG Advanced supplied scenario nativeS298-311/printed296-309 individually designated autonomous machine, same vehicle across controlled/autonomous states; unplayed.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: Authored excavation/controlled attack, device destruction/ejection/enemy classification and conditional wreckage/dependencies.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit; evidence-located calibration, countercases, bounded procedures and explicit gaps, without inherited project labels or independent validation.

dimensions.note: No human psychological model supplied. Counter: Procedural machine script explains behavior without invented emotions.
Object-history section: controlled-barrier state→device loss/autonomous enemy response. Counter: Authored control transition not second personality or developmental learning.
Announcements section: attack, emergency escape, life-response detection and eliminate-enemy lines. Counter: No pronoun/conversational comprehension/motive explanation or acoustic adequacy.
No ordinary tastes/routine supplied. Counter: Missing evidence not universal incapacity.
Boren command/control and ejected people target status change with device state. Counter: Control relation not affection, revenge, moral betrayal or negotiated friendship.
No private inner speech/affect given. Counter: Do not fabricate human mind to fill dimensions.

Power/weakness sections: drill/burrow, barrier/device dependency and postloss attacks/conditional destruction. Counter: Encounter formulas differ from general card; no universal forced-defeat experiment or exhaustive balance audit.
No ethical self-assessment or moral decision supplied. Counter: Hitting Boren not ethical rejection of coercion.
No intentional joke/play evidence. Counter: Conditional rear drill strike not authored personal humor.
Source-defined artificial actor in one Advanced supplied scenario/card. Counter: Unplayed, no actual wreckage/bounty/performance or independent test.
Failed Boren command, barrier removal, zero-defense encounter and theft obstacle qualify invincible/mastered descriptions. Counter: No guaranteed theft/drop or general robot psychology.

State/card/encounter, device vs vehicle, surviving actors and conditional immobility separated. Counter: No second machine, fixed global person count, actual completed ending or full golem architecture.

scenario_readiness.note: Monograph announcements/control-state sections supply fixed detection, evacuation and eliminate-enemy messages, not a procedure for comprehending and responding in a new conversation. Counter: Known state notifications can be reconstructed as script facts, but interactive conversation, motive explanation and a new interlocutor-sensitive voice are not established. This is not a claim artificial actors cannot speak.

Authored local agency map, not portable personality/control generator; procedural script remains rival. Counter: Source-bound limits and source-known testing remain; no independent predictive validation.

known_limits.statement: Artificial agency is substantial, but human emotion/family/remorse/inner voice not supplied; absence is gap not universal incapacity.
Device loss changes control/barrier/targeting in same machine, not a second person; device not automatically sentient companion.
Forced defeat, player-count HP, general card/encounter defense and conditional wreckage are authored contexts, not actual tests or guaranteed effects.
No directly curated independent predictive,native-human or acoustic validation is available in this evidence set; bounded generation is not general accuracy or maturity.
